name: xsolla-ai-kit
description: Xsolla agent skills toolkit — install the xsolla-ai-kit plugin to get guided, Xsolla-specific workflows from zero to a live game shop.

plugins.name: xsolla-ai-kit
plugins.description: Build any Xsolla game shop from one entry point (shop-setup): a shared foundation (merchant-setup, catalog-design, login-setup, webhooks-impl) then a choice of build path — headless (headless-storefront, headless-login, headless-checkout-integration) or Shop Builder (shopbuilder-storefront + site/page/blocks/customize/custom-block).
